justification: TypeScript distinguishes type and value spaces. Interface/type references must resolve in type space; type-only imports must remain type-space bindings and not be usable as runtime values. This case documents current resolver behavior for type references and type-only import bindings without simulating a full type checker.

cases.name: User
cases.note: Interface used as type annotation resolves as type reference

cases.name: Config
cases.note: Type-only import binding resolves as type-space reference
